name: Oracle Cards Lite – Interactive Card Deck Plugin for WordPress
author: emotionalonlinestorytelling

sections.description:
Add an Interactive Oracle Deck to Your WordPress Site.

Bring the magic of oracle card readings to your WordPress website with the Oracle Cards plugin. This easy-to-use tool lets you display a customizable, interactive deck of cards that visitors can shuffle and draw from. Perfect for spiritual websites, coaches, and content creators.

The plugin generates random card selections, enhancing user engagement and personalization.

Watch the video below to see the PRO version in action.

With the free version, each deck can include up to 15 cards, and you can choose from 4 predefined card backs.

Upgrade to the PRO version to unlock unlimited cards and the ability to upload your own custom card backs for a fully personalized experience.

HOW TO CREATE A DECK AND ADD IT TO YOUR PAGE

Create Your Oracle Card Deck

  • In your WordPress dashboard, go to Oracle Cards → Oracle Cards → Add New Deck
  • Enter a deck name and click “Add New Deck”
  • Choose the default card back and define the default card size
  • Set the card title prefix, or check the box to automatically use the file names of your uploaded images
  • Click “Upload Card Front Images” to add your cards

Add the Deck to a Page

  • Go to Oracle Cards in the main admin menu
  • Copy the shortcode from the last column (e.g. [oracle_cards deck=”1″])
  • Paste the shortcode into any page or post where you want the deck to appear

For a full list of shortcode parameters and advanced usage, check out the plugin documentation.

Compatibility

Oracle Cards is compatible with all major page builders and WordPress themes.
If you experience any issues with your preferred theme or builder, don’t hesitate to open a thread in the support forum.
sections.installation:
• Upload the entire oracle-cards folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via the Plugins page in your WordPress dashboard.
  • Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  • Once activated, go to Oracle Cards → Add Deck to create your first deck.
